activity_summary: You sat in the family pew at Holy Trinity and counted the row: your mother, Anne, three children, Joan, and two brothers. Your father was the gap. The sermon was on patience. Anne said she had asked her question yesterday and would not ask it under a hymn. You told her you had not brought a fourth answer. No one filled the gap. The vicar was not named.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the row and a gap, and said he had no fourth answer.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept yesterday's question out of the pew.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the empty place empty, and gave the neighbours a plain reason.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Set Richard and Edmund in the row, and would not let the gap be used as a seat.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat on William's left, and did not speak.

entities.name: Edmund Shakespeare
entities.context: Offered to sit forward, and was told to stay.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the word patience, and said the sword was still on the nail.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the word and not the smile, and called the sword an inventory.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard in the row. He did not fill the gap.

facets.activity: Counted the pew at Holy Trinity, and Father was the gap

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Mother, Anne, three children, Joan, two brothers. One gap.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: I asked my question yesterday. I am not asking it under a hymn.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have not brought thee a fourth answer in my pocket.
